WITH filtered_retail AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        InvoiceNo
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)

    COALESCE(cr.revenue_pence, 0) AS revenue_pence,

FROM data.customers c

ORDER BY c.CustomerID

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail 
  WHERE UnitPrice > 0 AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_base AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM customers
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f2.InvoiceNo) FROM filtered f2 JOIN customer_base c2 ON f2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID WHERE f2.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND f2.CustomerID = c.CustomerID), 0) AS invoice_count

)

models.sql:
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    r.InvoiceNo,
    r.Quantity,
    r.UnitPrice,
    r.CustomerID,
    r.InvoiceDate
  FROM data.retail r
  WHERE r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND r.Quantity > 0 
    AND r.UnitPrice > 0 
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM data.customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;

) SELECT

FROM data.customers c
LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID

models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice
  FROM retail
  WHERE 
    -- Date filter: start inclusive, end exclusive
    InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00' 
    AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
    -- Exclude C invoices (cancellations)
    AND UPPER(InvoiceNo) NOT LIKE 'C%'
    -- Exclude nonpositive quantities
    AND Quantity > 0
    -- Exclude nonpositive prices
    AND UnitPrice > 0
    -- Exclude missing CustomerID
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_ids AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM data.customers
),
metrics_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN customer_ids c ON f.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT * FROM metrics_calc
ORDER BY CustomerID

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, InvoiceNo, Quantity, UnitPrice
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' COLLATE BINARY
    AND Quantity > 0
    AND UnitPrice > 0
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_ids AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM customers
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    ROUND(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice * 100))::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
  FROM customer_ids c
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  COALESCE(revenue_pence, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
  COALESCE(invoice_count, 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY CustomerID
